question: In Arc 10, characters from The Prophecy of the Throne appear. At the time you were supervising The Prophecy of the Throne, did you already have plans such as “Let's have the characters introduced here appear in the main story later,” or conversely, “Let's introduce characters here who are planned to appear in the main story later”?
answer:
If I had been thinking that far ahead at the time, that would have been a bit too ambitious. (Laughs) I certainly wasn't creating them while thinking, “Let's have them appear in Arc 10 later.”

The members of the Dragon Church, such as Tiga, who appear in Arc 10, actually made their first appearance in the game The Prophecy of the Throne. Of course, since the story couldn't be exactly the same as in the game, I've had them appear while making various small changes to their roles and positions.

They are also characters I feel strongly attached to, since Mr. Otsuka designed their characters and I was heavily involved in coming up with their settings. And because the new situation I had prepared for Arc 10 happened to fit their positions and circumstances, I decided to bring them in.

Of course, I also have this feeling of “Since I've gone to the trouble of introducing these characters, I want to make as much use of them as possible,” or, so to speak, “keep chewing on them until they have no flavor left.” That's why I had them appear.

Of course, I've made it so that you can enjoy Arc 10 even if you haven't played the game. But after finishing the arc, if you go and play The Prophecy of the Throne as well, you might be able to enjoy seeing them in a different role and position—getting two different experiences out of the same characters.
